component.name: LogLens
component.summary: See every service's logs and what they mean

description.p: LogLens finds the logs on your Linux computer (systemd services, Docker containers and Compose projects, and log files such as Squid, ClamAV and nginx), shows each service's logs live and separately, and explains in plain language what is happening: what an entry means, its probable cause and what to do next.

ul.li: Live, searchable logs per service, smooth with millions of lines
Plain-language explanations from tested rule packs, no AI or network needed
Per-service overview: error spikes, top clients and domains, restarts, health
A dashboard for Docker Compose projects
Passwords, tokens and keys are removed before anything is stored

description.p: First release: discovery, live logs, explanations, overviews, redaction and the read-only helper.
